method: Actual DOM parsing and application-script execution in jsdom, using the same user actions and data across arms. No external resource loading. Scroll and dialog rendering are stubbed. Storage is snapshotted between DOM instances.
limits: Not a browser, layout, file:// storage, native keyboard traversal, download, or real-user test. The suite checks selected behaviors, not all possible states.

checks.name: Fresh startup executes without runtime errors and has an editable story
Typed draft and title persist exactly
Changing only the place preserves the other prompts and writing
Finish saves exact content and opens its reading state
Starting another story preserves an unfinished ending through a reload
Storage failure does not clear the working draft on New story
Legacy draft and out-of-deck prompts remain exact
Both legacy stories remain readable without replacing the current draft
Removal retains the complete story and persists through reload
No unexpected script errors occurred during the matched flow
